items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1961-05-22
items.q: I waked it there, then I waked at the moonlight up on St. Charles and Paul Jitney. And Paul Jitney upstairs.

ctx.x: Well those girls, did they make out all right with that money? Well I think they got about a half or something. Oh yeah, they made out all right.
Made all right. I waked it there, then I waked at the moonlight up on St. Charles and Paul Jitney. And Paul Jitney upstairs.
